Preflight Demo Program
DEMO-PROGRAM-ALPHA
DOC-0049 2026-09-01
RETROSPECTIVE — Duplicate Intake Tickets Lost Their
Shared Source
Date: 2026-09-01
Program: DEMO-PROGRAM-ALPHA
Recorder: PERSON-0026, TEAM-0002
What happened During an electrical intake discussion, a copied card was
treated as a fresh submission because its source heading had been shortened.
The desk began a separate collecting conversation before comparing the
original question. ISSUE-0074 and TASK-0195 locate the teaching folder;
TASK-0194 remains a separate attachment reference.
What helped The filing clerk retained the sender's original heading on the
index copy. Comparing that heading with the intake card made the
relationship between the papers understandable without relying on
recollection. The desk could then discuss whether the scope was genuinely
shared instead of assuming that similar subsystem labels proved a duplicate.
What changes The intake clerk will check the origin heading before preparing
a new cover. Use two-touch intake to preserve the sender's question at the first
touch and verify the destination and expected reply date at the receiving
touch. That conversation should also identify whether the submission refers
back to an existing question.
Any merge proposal keeps both issue references on the eventual cover sheet,
with a reason for choosing the continuing entry. This retrospective does not
identify a duplicate partner for the teaching reference.
Follow-up PERSON-0026 will review the revised intake-card layout with the
filing clerk on 2026-09-08. The origin-heading space and the sender's question
must remain readable after copying.
D. Worker 0026
Demo Worker 0026, Demo Team 02
